en-US.title: Essential for New Moms🔥 Here's how to sterilize baby bottles in boiling water! 🍼🧴 #shorts
en-US.description:
Essential for New Moms🔥 Here's How to Sterilize Baby Bottles in Boiling Water! 🍼🧴

1. Prepare baby bottle detergent

2. Pump baby bottle detergent 1-2 times into the sink

3. Turn on hot water

4. Separate the bottles while the water fills

5. Put the separated bottles in and let them soak for 5 minutes

6. Rinse thoroughly with a bottle brush

7. Prepare boiling water

8. Turn off the heat and sterilize in boiling water

9. Dry on a drying rack

💡 It's convenient if you put the detergent in the sink first and turn on the water; you don't need to dissolve the detergent!

⚠️ For nipples, cover the hole with your finger while wiping! (Caution: May tear)

⚠️ Glass bottles: Within 2 minutes

PPSU bottles: Within 1 minute

Nipples: Sterilize in boiling water for within 30 seconds!

snippet.title: 해외여행 하루 전 찾아온 아기 | 연하 남편의 노산 발언 & 부모님 임밍아웃 | 임신 4–9주
snippet.description:
해외여행을 하루 앞두고
생각지도 못하게 찾아온 두 줄.

계획 임신도 아니었고,
임신 준비도 없이 갑작스럽게 찾아온 아기였어요.

여행을 가야 할지, 말아야 할지
머릿속이 복잡해진 그날의 기록과
연하 남편의 솔직한 반응,
그리고 부모님께 임신 소식을 전했던 순간까지
임신 초기 4–9주의 이야기를 담았습니다.

노산이라는 말이 이렇게 현실적으로 다가올 줄 몰랐고,
기쁘면서도 불안했던 감정들을
있는 그대로 남겨보고 싶었어요.

비슷한 시기를 지나고 있는 분들,
혹은 갑작스러운 임신 소식에
혼란을 겪고 있는 누군가에게
조금이나마 공감이 되었으면 합니다.

오늘도 영상 보러 와주셔서 감사합니다 🤍

en-US.title: Baby arrives a day before overseas travel | Younger husband's comment about late labor & parents'...
en-US.description:
Two unexpected lines arrived just a day before my overseas trip.

It wasn't a planned pregnancy,
and the baby arrived unexpectedly, without any preparation.

I documented that day, when I was in a state of confusion about whether or not to go on the trip,
my younger husband's honest reaction,
and even the moment I told my parents the news.

I captured the early stages of my pregnancy, from weeks 4 to 9.

I never imagined the concept of late labor would be so real,
and I wanted to capture those emotions, both joyful and anxious, as they were.

I hope this can provide some resonance to those going through a similar situation,
or to anyone else who is confused by the sudden news of pregnancy.

Thank you for watching today's video! 🤍
